{{Quote|So much for the ''Jedi escort''.|General Grievous|audio=JediEscort-SoM.flac|<ref name="Shadow of Malevolence" />}}
A '''battle''' took place in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] in the [[Ryndellia system/Legends|Ryndellia system]] as part of the [[Malevolence Campaign/Legends|''Malevolence'' Campaign]]. A [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] medical convoy consisting of several [[Pelta-class frigate/Legends|''Pelta''-class frigates]] and a [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] escort, commanded by [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] and [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], was passing through the [[Ryndellia/Legends|Ryndellia]] [[Star system/Legends|system]]. The convoy was ambushed by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] [[Subjugator-class heavy cruiser/Legends|''Subjugator''-class heavy cruiser]] [[Malevolence/Legends|''Malevolence'']], under the command of [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]]. The Confederate [[Warship/Legends|warship]] eliminated the Republic [[Transport/Legends|transports]] with its [[Turbolaser/Legends|laser guns]] and neutralized the power of the final fleeing [[Frigate/Legends|frigate]] with its [[Ion pulse cannon/Legends|ion pulse cannons]]. On Confederate [[Head of State/Legends|Head of State]] [[Count of Serenno/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku's]] orders, the ''Malevolence'' headed to [[Battle of the Kaliida Nebula/Legends|attack]] a [[Kaliida Shoals Medical Center/Legends|Republic medical center]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] that was treating over 60,000 wounded Republic [[Cloning/Legends|clones]].

==Prelude==
{{Quote|Now the Republic will learn of our ion cannon!''"<br />"''Your failure is most unfortunate. I will have to ''discuss'' this with my Master.|Grievous and Count Dooku, shortly after Grievous' failure to stop a Republic ship from fleeing|audio=OurIonCannon-RM.flac|<ref name="Rising Malevolence">{{TCW|Rising Malevolence|Rising ''Malevolence''}}</ref>}}
[[File:Battle_of_Abregado.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The ''Malevolence'' attacks Plo Koon's fleet in the Abregado system.]]
In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="FF-2014 24: Malevolence" /> during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] built a [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]], the [[Subjugator-class heavy cruiser/Legends|''Subjugator''-class heavy cruiser]] [[Malevolence/Legends|''Malevolence'']], that was capable of defeating numerous [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Fleet/Legends|fleets]] at a time with its [[Ion pulse cannon/Legends|ion pulse cannons]]. The [[Ion cannon/Legends|cannons]] neutralized the power of their targets, leaving the quarries vulnerable to [[Laser/Legends|laser]] fire from the ''Malevolence'' without the ability to use [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shields]].<ref name="Rising Malevolence" /> Under the command of [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]], the ''Malevolence'' [[Malevolence Campaign/Legends|eliminated several Republic task forces]], leaving no survivors to spread the news of the [[Warship/Legends|warship]] or its unforeseen ion [[Cannon/Legends|cannons]]. Because its origins and methods of attack were unknown to the Republic, the ''Malevolence'' was dubbed the "mystery weapon." The random targets did not hint at a pattern,<ref name="Shakedown">''[[The Clone Wars: Shakedown]]''</ref> and the unpredictability of future targets spread fear across the citizens of the Republic.<ref name="A Galaxy Divided">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/hnn/001.html#rss|text=HoloNet News &mdash; A Galaxy Divided|int=HoloNet News &mdash; A Galaxy Divided}}</ref>

After [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]] tracked the ''Malevolence'' to the [[Abregado system/Legends|Abregado system]], his fleet of several [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyers]] was [[Battle of Abregado/Legends|attacked]] by the [[Starship/Legends|warship's]] ion cannons on Grievous's order. The Confederate [[Head of State/Legends|Head of State]] [[Count of Serenno/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] was aboard the warship and ordered the pods to be eliminated, not intending to allow the Republic to learn of the warship and its weapons. However, Koon and several [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] were rescued by [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] General [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Jedi Commander/Legends|Jedi Commander]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], and were able to escape the ''Malevolence'', taking the knowledge of the warship to the Republic. Dooku considered the battle to be a defeat, and his trust in Grievous was diminished,<ref name="Rising Malevolence" /> while Grievous himself resolved to ambush other Republic forces.<ref name="Shadow of Malevolence" /> Grievous cut a swath of destruction in the [[Vanik system/Legends|Vanik]], [[Ichtor system/Legends|Ichtor]], and [[Vondarc system/Legends|Vondarc systems]] before arriving in the [[Ryndellia system/Legends|Ryndellia system]].<ref name="Warfare" />

==The battle==
{{Quote|Target those escape pods! I have a reputation to uphold.|General Grievous|audio=ReputationToUphold-SoM.flac|<ref name="Shadow of Malevolence" />}}
[[File:Malevolence_targets_frigate.png|thumb|right|250px|The ''Malevolence'' targets the fleeing ''Pelta''-class frigate with its ion cannons.]]
A Republic medical convoy, consisting of several [[Pelta-class frigate/Legends|''Pelta''-class frigates]] as well as a ''Venator''-class [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] escort,<ref name="Shadow of Malevolence" /> was passing through the Ryndellia system<ref name="Shadow of Malevolence Ep Guide" /> when it was intercepted by General Grievous and the ''Malevolence'' near the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ryndellia/Legends|Ryndellia]]. The warship attacked the [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] and two of the [[Frigate/Legends|frigates]] with its numerous [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] cannons, while the last frigate fled. Noticing this, Grievous ordered the ship's ion cannons to be fired at the frigate. The [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] piloting the vessel attempted to jump to [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] but were unable to set the coordinates in time to do so. The frigate's power was neutralized by the ion cannons, and the ''Malevolence'' directed laser fire at it. When a [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droid]] commented on his inability to target anything, Grievous smashed the droid aside.<ref name="Shadow of Malevolence" />

Dooku was watching the [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] general's progress through a [[Hologram/Legends|holotransmission]] and was pleased that the medical convoy had been eliminated.<ref name="Shadow of Malevolence" /> The [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] had recently met with his [[Palpatine/Legends|Sith Master]] and had learned of the Republic's secret [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Kaliida Shoals Medical Center/Legends|medical center]], which was treating over 60,000 wounded clones.<ref name="Shadow of Malevolence Decoded">{{TCW|Shadow of Malevolence|Shadow of ''Malevolence''|d=y}}</ref> Dooku assigned the [[Medcenter/Legends|medical center]] as the ''Malevolence''{{'s}} new target, and the assignment boosted Grievous's confidence, as it showed that the [[Count/Legends|count]] had not completely lost his faith in the general since his recent setback at Abregado. As the damaged frigate deployed several escape pods, Grievous ordered the pods to be targeted.<ref name="Shadow of Malevolence" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|Skywalker. The enemy warship has attacked our convoy of medical transports near Ryndellia.''"<br />"Medical transports? ''Only General Grievous would go after clones who can't fight back.''"<br />"''The Ryndellia system. Near Naboo! Isn't that where our medical base is? I'll bet that will be his next target.|Admiral Wullf Yularen, Ahsoka Tano, and Anakin Skywalker|audio=RyndelliaSystem-SoM.flac|<ref name="Shadow of Malevolence" />}}
Following Dooku's orders, the ''Malevolence'' jumped to hyperspace and headed for the medical center. General Anakin Skywalker received a report from [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Wullf Yularen/Legends|Wullf Yularen]] of the medical convoy's destruction in the Ryndellia system, and the Jedi deduced that Grievous was heading for the medical station. As Skywalker had already planned a counterattack on the ''Malevolence'', he intended to [[Battle of the Kaliida Nebula/Legends|intercept]] the warship before it could attack the medical base. Skywalker led [[Shadow Squadron/Legends|Shadow Squadron]]<ref name="Shadow of Malevolence" /> in recently acquired [[BTL-B Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL-B Y-wing starfighters]]<ref name="Procedure">''[[The Clone Wars: Procedure]]''</ref> on a [[Balmorra Run/Legends|shortcut]] through the [[Kaliida Nebula/Legends|Kaliida Nebula]], and was accompanied by his Padawan, Ahsoka Tano, as well as General Plo Koon. Admiral Yularen warned the [[Kaminoan/Legends|Kaminoan]] [[Nala Se/Legends|Nala Se]]&mdash;the medical station's administrator<ref name="Shadow of Malevolence Ep Guide" />&mdash;of the impending danger, and the station began evacuations of its patients.<ref name="Shadow of Malevolence" />

==Behind the scenes==
The battle of the Ryndellia system appeared in "[[Shadow of Malevolence|Shadow of ''Malevolence'']]," the third episode in the [[The Clone Wars: Season One|first season]] of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series that aired on [[October 10]], [[2008]].<ref name="Shadow of Malevolence Ep Guide" />
